# Stride boundary

Repository: https://github.com/stride3d/stride.git

Audited commit: `cc3f993de7a8263ebbc14d12d5dcbbe93e31f6e9`

Status: audit-only. The repository-root license is MIT, but the dependency inventory includes separately licensed components such as FFmpeg GPL-3 and Gettext LGPL-2.1, among other runtime/editor dependencies. Its C# engine/editor architecture is not a wholesale link target for the native C++ UVE runtime. No Stride source, binary, asset, logo, or engine subsystem is bundled or linked by UVE.
